mechanism.recording: One actual ending trigger chooses an existing owner hand entity and a non-equipment card name. Names may repeat under the complete current text. Each issued deposit has its own ID and exact source instance; consumed IDs stay consumed if the same entity later returns and is recorded again.
mechanism.privatePile: Owner-only physical card and recorded-name pairs, others see count only. No secret record name appears in public log. Temporary suppression does not discard; actual grant removal or death moves remaining real entities to discard.
mechanism.eligibility: Other actual actor, outside skill owner's actual turn, positive physical materials, provider equals actor, every captured material originated in that actor's real hand. Same-name Slash family includes fire and thunder Slash. Converted hand equipment and Zhangba two-hand inputs qualify; mixed hand/equipment, equipment-zone inputs, WoodenOx grain, another provider's supplied response and zero-entity virtual uses do not qualify.
mechanism.eligibilityInterpretation: The complete current main/client says hand use. The all-material origin and supplied-response exclusions follow the engine's captured hand-use and use-versus-play model. No current official combination FAQ was found for mixed HE, WoodenOx or supplied cards; these combinations are explicitly inference, not claimed FAQ text.
mechanism.invalidation: Move exactly one matching live deposit to discard, drain real movement children, retain the precise paid action/window proof and immutable original actual hand-use action. Normal Use preserves committed/finalized/completed processing and globally suppresses the effect, including added targets. A later role or kind change must prove the same original material/provider/action and actual issued mutation history; hand qualification stays at issuance. Delayed placement does not enter judgment. Real Alcohol commit retains quota while drink effect is canceled. Dodge is a true used response only against Slash, not ArrowBarrage played defense or Duel played Slash; canceled Dodge completes its real cost/observers then does not block Slash.
mechanism.counterspell: Only a live enabled matching off-turn ambush participant against an all-actor-hand counterspell creates a typed deferred response on the native nullification frame. Actual use chain depth is retained, effect boolean is applied after response observers: canceled use leaves the original boolean, accepted uncanceled use flips it. Without a qualifying ambush participant the old native immediate path remains.
mechanism.benyu: One actual sourced damage occurrence, not per point. Freeze source hand count X on the owning program frame. Draw to min(X,5) without discarding excess owner hand; or select and atomically discard at least X+1 real hand cards and deal one damage to the actual source after movement children. Once exact hand payment is issued, source-skill loss or owner death does not repay or revoke its retaliation while the game continues and the original damage source remains alive. Game end or death of that target stops the not-yet-issued retaliation.
mechanism.paidOwnerDeathInterpretation: Both skills finish already-paid effects after real movement children, including true non-Lord skill-owner death while the game continues. This applies the project's general issued-effect contract. No dedicated same-version official FAQ for death inside these payment children was found.
mechanism.zeroDrawInterpretation: Current text does not impose the historical hand-size conditions or exclude zero draw. The draw branch remains a true chosen activation when the capped refill is zero; it differs from declining. This is a literal current-rule interpretation without a dedicated current zero-draw FAQ.
